runs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create paint_front.png: a 1024 x 1024 RGBA texture-source painting of the provided FRONT orthographic guide, with actual transparent background.

INPUT ROLES, IN ORDER:
1. guide_front.png — the EDIT TARGET, absolute authority for geometry, silhouette, every opening, camera, size and placement.
2. design_reference.png — approved colour and surface-material reference ONLY. Do not copy its three-quarter camera, its lighting, or change the guide to its geometry.
3. concept_crop.png — original concept for context only; do not include the creature or setting.

Change only the grey surface colours of image 1. Treat its alpha mask and every model edge as locked. Keep its exact 1024 x 1024 canvas and existing margins: overall object spans x=262..761 and y=66..957. Do not rescale, crop, rotate, shift, reframe, straighten, symmetrize, or remodel anything. Reproduce the original irregular shapes exactly. The frontal ladder stays at the same central-left position, with the same thin rails, the same rungs and every transparent gap. The two apparent front pylons, splayed root feet, curved internal braces, solid upper under-deck panel, top spikes, and edge-on platform all stay exactly as in the guide. Do not invent extra openings in the solid panel or fill any existing opening. Empty pixels including between braces and rungs must remain alpha zero.

Paint the reference materials onto the existing surfaces: black-violet resin struts, braces, roots and ladder rails with restrained worn gold edging; aged white ceramic pylons with fine cracks and brushed gold bands; ivory bone ladder ribs and top spikes; a narrow saturated orange light strip on the existing pylon surface and orange inset sacs/seams where the reference's material language applies; dark worn alloy deck plates. Fine cracks, scuffs and material markings are colour detail only, not new geometry. Do not add any rubble outside the guide silhouette.

LIGHTING IS ALBEDO ONLY: flat, even, shadowless illumination from the viewer, equal exposure on all surfaces. No cast shadows, ambient occlusion, darkened creases from lighting, directional shading, strong specular highlights, reflections, rim light or bloom. Orange elements are painted orange with luminous-colour centers, with NO light spill onto nearby surfaces. Match the reference's material colours, not its studio lighting. No background, floor, ground shadow, vignette, text, labels, watermark, creature or scenic objects. Return one unresized 1024 x 1024 transparent PNG. Exact guide silhouette and holes take precedence over decorative detail.

2. design_reference.png — authority for colour and materials ONLY, not camera or geometry.
3. concept_crop.png — original concept context only, not subjects or scenery to add.

Paint the grey surfaces of image 1 without changing the model. Preserve its exact top-down orthographic view, the slight in-plane rotation, and its large transparent margins. Entire object bounds are x=261..762, y=262..761 on the 1024 square canvas. The deck is the small central rotated square, surrounded by the existing irregular four pylon/root-foot clusters visible from above. Border/railing and root struts are black-violet resin with restrained brushed gold edges and bands. Existing horn/spike/pylon surfaces are warm ivory bone and aged off-white ceramic with fine hairline cracks. Small inset sacs/seams are saturated glowing orange colour only, where visible within existing surfaces. The visible root-foot areas retain the exact guide shapes and use black-violet resin roots, white ceramic pylon portions, gold bands and sparse rust-red stone colour where existing model pieces correspond to stones. All decoration is colour within the guide's existing outline.

FLAT ALBEDO LIGHTING: even shadowless illumination from the viewer across the whole object. No cast shadows under the railing or horns, no ambient occlusion, no directional shading, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light, no glow halo, no vignette. Orange inset colours do not illuminate surrounding surfaces. This is surface colour for texture projection, not a lit beauty render. No background, floor, ground plane, checkerboard, creature, environment, labels, text or watermark. Every background pixel and hole must be genuinely transparent. Exact silhouette and placement outrank decorative detail. Return ONE 1024x1024 PNG.
